task: Reproduce and close record-identity, recursive risk, registered deletion, and retrieval-accounting bypasses without claiming live extraction qualification.
scope: OpenLunum only, main only; no existing process or external repository changes
hypothesis: Record creation, canonical recursive risk assessment, registered-derivative deletion, and raw-text retrieval accounting have bypasses or denominator errors that deterministic adversarial fixtures can reproduce and prevent.
visionGuardrails: Original source evidence is authoritative and recoverable.
Semantics and stable identity remain model- and language-independent; open strings are not proof of referent identity.
Candidate identity is not verified semantics or promotion.
Surface, exact semantic, and near-semantic identities remain distinct and versioned.
Retrieval augments proven retrieval methods; rendering and compaction are separate hypotheses.
Unsafe or uncertain interpretations fail closed, remain observable, and retain natural evidence.
Derived data inherits source sensitivity, bounded retention, and deletion linkage.
Failed and frozen evaluation evidence is immutable; model-only judgment is not human/native qualification.
areas: source-bound candidate identity at record creation
canonical modality and recursive condition/consequence risk assessment
registry-derived deletion plan completeness and lineage
raw retrieval routing, pool, failure-stage and metric accounting

data.source: existing visible repository tests and new deterministic adversarial fixtures

dataset.hashNote: Hashes name the baseline test inputs, not subsequent adversarial extensions.

hardGates: source-literal mismatch cannot issue source-bound exact identity or promotion through createRecord
canonical obligation and safety-critical nested conditions/consequences cannot evade risk assessment
incomplete, forged, stale or lineage-mismatched deletion plans cannot execute or claim cascade completion
routing-ineligible equivalent records are not semantic false positives
confusion counts use an explicit common routed raw-memory universe
extraction failures and baseline exceptions are not successful negative rejection or semantic matching failures
owner work and existing processes remain untouched
nonClaims: No live semantic accuracy, deployed deletion, embedding, compaction, or OpenUnum integration result is established by this experiment.
No readiness decision follows merely from deterministic tests.
